mapper.sql: ID, NAME, PROJECT_NO, CATEGORY, CREATED_BY, VERSION_NO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PROJECT (ID, NAME, PROJECT_NO, CATEGORY, CREATED_BY, VERSION_NO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.name}, #{row.projectNo}, #{row.category}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.versionNo}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM PROJECT WHERE ID = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ID DESC) ROW_NO FROM PROJECT WHERE VERSION_NO > 0 AND (INSTR(UPPER(NAME), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR INSTR(UPPER(PROJECT_NO), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0) ) X WHERE ROW_NO > #{offset} AND ROW_NO <= #{endRow} ORDER BY ROW_NO
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECT WHERE VERSION_NO > 0 AND (INSTR(UPPER(NAME), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR INSTR(UPPER(PROJECT_NO), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0)

SELECT ID, NAME, PROJECT_NO, CATEGORY, CREATED_BY, VERSION_NO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM ( SELECT P.ID, P.NAME, P.PROJECT_NO, P.CATEGORY, P.CREATED_BY, P.VERSION_NO, P.CREATED_AT, P.UPDATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.ID DESC) ROW_NO FROM PROJECT P WHERE P.VERSION_NO = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_FILE PF WHERE PF.PROJECT_ID = P.ID AND PF.CATEGORY = 'PACKAGE') ) X WHERE ROW_NO > #{offset} AND ROW_NO <= #{endRow} ORDER BY ROW_NO
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECT P WHERE P.VERSION_NO = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_FILE PF WHERE PF.PROJECT_ID = P.ID AND PF.CATEGORY = 'PACKAGE')

SELECT PROJECT_ID, CREATED_AT, UPLOADED_FILE_COUNT FROM ( SELECT P.ID PROJECT_ID, P.CREATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECT_FILE PFC WHERE PFC.PROJECT_ID = P.ID) UPLOADED_FILE_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.ID DESC) ROW_NO FROM PROJECT P WHERE P.VERSION_NO = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_FILE PF WHERE PF.PROJECT_ID = P.ID) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_FILE PF WHERE PF.PROJECT_ID = P.ID AND PF.CATEGORY = 'PACKAGE' ) ) X WHERE ROW_NO > #{offset} AND ROW_NO <= #{endRow} ORDER BY ROW_NO

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PROJECT P WHERE P.VERSION_NO = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_FILE PF WHERE PF.PROJECT_ID = P.ID) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECT_FILE PF WHERE PF.PROJECT_ID = P.ID AND PF.CATEGORY = 'PACKAGE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE PROJECT SET NAME=#{row.name}, PROJECT_NO=#{row.projectNo}, CATEGORY=#{row.category}, VERSION_NO=#{row.versionNo}, UPDATED_AT=#{row.updatedAt} WHERE ID=#{row.id} AND VERSION_NO=#{expectedVersion}
